column5: README describes attachment export as optional, but the script unconditionally saves every attachment with pastaDestino.createFile.
The optional attachment export claim contradicts the unconditional attachment-saving loop at script lines 49–52.
parseGitHubUrl omits the URL branch from its result, and resolveIdentifier always fetches the repository default branch.
The explicit tree URL branch is discarded by parseGitHubUrl and replaced with the default branch by resolveIdentifier.

downloadEntries passes the manifest repository's location.ref to every entry even when entry.owner and entry.repository identify another repository.
safePath uses resolved.startsWith(baseDir), which accepts sibling directory paths sharing the base directory's textual prefix.

Every FileEntry is converted to a GitHubSource using the parent skillset's location.ref regardless of its repository.
The sibling-directory exploit targets safePath's textual startsWith containment check rather than a directory-boundary check.

The candidate spans unchecked user-controlled regex compilation in validation and catastrophic-backtracking exposure during synchronous execution.

init skips the existing fallback when tools are detected, but checkStaleness still includes it, matching G2's obsolete fallback entry issue.
